name: core30-starter
//: deploy:* read the Cloudflare Pages project from $CF_PAGES_PROJECT (see .env.example). It is client config; npm scripts cannot read site.config.json, so it travels as an env var rather than being hardcoded per client.

scripts.build: npm run config:gen && astro build && npm run lint
scripts.build:cf: npm run config:gen && astro build && node scripts/stamp-noindex-if-preview.mjs && npm run lint
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run config:gen && astro build && node scripts/stamp-staging-noindex.mjs && npm run lint && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/deploy.mjs staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/deploy.mjs prod
